answer_text: Laundry services are available daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Regular laundry is typically returned within 24 hours, while express service is available for an additional charge. You can place your laundry in the designated bag and contact housekeeping for collection. For dry cleaning, professional services are available for delicate garments, with items collected before 10:00 AM usually returned by the following evening. Charges vary depending on the garment type and are added to your final bill.
